title: EnvelopeFile doc missing note that fields contain PII email addresses
description: EnvelopeFile has a one-line doc comment but no note that mail_from and rcpt_to contain PII email addresses. A future contributor adding a debug log of the struct would not be warned. Add a doc note: '/// Note: fields contain PII (sender/recipient email addresses) — do not log in production.' This is especially relevant now that Debug is derived.
